verdict.rationale: The pack has no documentation of multi-subscription or management-group isolation patterns, landing zones, sandbox subscriptions, or policy guardrails that keep experiments away from prod. Azure RBAC scoping and budget alerts are related access and cost controls, not documented isolation patterns. Service-level local emulators and the retired Learn sandbox do not deliver project isolation either.

support.subject: As a developer, experiments cannot hurt prod — documented multi-account/project isolation patterns (org units, sandboxes) with guardrails
